target: Replace the falsified merged-tail binary-origin reduction with a correct mixed-parent Resolution closure theorem and isolate the remaining GT-specific parent-class reduction.

falsified_hypothesis.name: Merged-Tail Binary-Origin Reduction as a pure graph theorem
falsified_hypothesis.statement: Every new non-tail bridge produced from a component-spanning parent and a directed-cycle parent must be born on a two-component quotient from binary parents.

minimum_abstract_witness.effect: The shared literal 0->1 is non-bridge in both parents and becomes a bridge in the resolvent, while the resolvent remains component-spanning.

falsified_hypothesis.interpretation: Bridge birth does not imply rank loss. Binary origin and two-component localization are stronger than necessary for local safety.

proved_theorem.name: Spanning/Cycle Resolution Closure
proved_theorem.statement: For any legal non-tautological Resolution inference on a fixed quotient, if one parent is component-spanning and the other contains a directed cycle, then the resolvent is component-spanning or contains a directed cycle.
proof_core: If deleting the pivot from the spanning parent preserves connectivity, the resolvent is spanning.
Otherwise the pivot is a bridge and defines a cut S|T.
If the resolvent remains disconnected, the cycle parent has no non-pivot edge across S|T.
A directed cycle using the pivot must cross the cut again, contradicting the previous item.
Therefore a directed cycle avoiding the pivot survives in the legal resolvent.
proved_theorem.consequence: A COMPONENT_SPANNING plus DIRECTED_CYCLE parent pair cannot produce UNSAFE_ACYCLIC_LOW_RANK.

finite_reachability_evidence.observed_parent_class_claim: Every fresh occurrence has unordered parent classes {COMPONENT_SPANNING, DIRECTED_CYCLE}.
finite_reachability_evidence.claim_boundary: The finite certificate does not prove the arbitrary-n GT parent-class reduction.

corrected_remaining_local_gate.name: Fresh Bad-Bridge Parent-Class Reduction
corrected_remaining_local_gate.statement: For arbitrary n, every fresh non-tail bridge occurrence produced by the deterministic one-pass local Resolution stage in a reachable pre-frontier GT residual has one component-spanning parent and one directed-cycle parent.
corrected_remaining_local_gate.payoff: The proved mixed-parent closure theorem then establishes immediate local safety without binary-origin, two-component, or extinction assumptions.

falsification_conditions: Produce a legal mixed spanning/cycle Resolution whose resolvent is unsafe acyclic low-rank.
Produce a reachable pre-frontier fresh non-tail bridge whose parent-class pair is not component-spanning plus directed-cycle.
Produce an arbitrary-n GT construction violating the parent-class reduction.
Produce a surviving singleton-tail lineage that merges its tail before shielding.
Map exponentially many historical frontier restrictions to polynomially many exact Policy-0A cache states without paying an equivalent proof or terminal charge.
claim_boundary: This amendment proves a one-inference quotient-graph closure theorem and records finite GT parent-class evidence through GT_8. It does not prove the arbitrary-n GT parent-class reduction, the global Policy-0A lower bound, or P versus NP.
